title:
Transforms info received by `Reliability.SensorsGrid` Grid.
Used to:
   - Add new field `displayNumOpenAlerts` which is equal to {@link Sensor#numOpenSensorAlerts} if that value is
     greater than 0, otherwise it is an empty string.
   - When a sensor in {@link SensorOperationalStatusEnum#FAULTY} status has an existing {@link SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue#endDate},
     a new field is created by concatenating the locally formatted date with a translated prefix.
   - If there is any {@link Sensor} without an {@link Sensor#operationalStatus}, add a default value so that they are treated as
     {@link SensorOperationalStatusEnum#OPERATIONAL} in the UI.
name: TransformSensorsGrid
